scope.description: Named deep-dossier refresh for published H2 Analytics, examining the official EASE product platform, DND procurement, NRC IRAP product-development support, parliamentary evidence and independent Ottawa-sector reporting.

source.title: EASE Platform
source.locator: Create, Generate, Integrate, Monitor and Evaluate sections
source.summary: H2's official EASE page documents AI-enabled exercise entity and intelligence-traffic generation, external simulation and tracker integration, real-time exercise control and post-exercise reporting.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official EASE workflow, CanadaBuys DND contract history, NRC IRAP contribution record, House of Commons testimony and independent Ottawa-sector reporting.
followUpQuestions: Can CAE publish a durable corporate announcement that corroborates its CANSEC 2026 LinkedIn post about the H2 Analytics teaming agreement?
Should future DND contract records clarify the specific EASE license scope or operational outcomes beyond the public award data?
reviewWarnings: CAE's CANSEC 2026 LinkedIn post describes a teaming agreement with H2 Analytics to pursue CAF collective-training opportunities, but no durable CAE or DND announcement was recovered; it remains discovery provenance only.
The public DND contract establishes title, buyer, award, dates, procurement method and value, but does not disclose user scope, training outcomes or classified requirements.
The Ottawa Business Journal's exercise count, employee count and market-expansion statements are secondary reporting and are not imported as canonical performance facts.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Official product documentation resolved concrete EASE functions, including templates, AI-enabled report generation, tracker and simulation integration, shared exercise control and assessment reporting.
CanadaBuys resolved the amended C$1,352,462.75 DND EASE contract, directed procurement basis, award date, expiry and recipient identity.
The NRC IRAP record resolved a C$299,562 contribution for EASE simulation-capability integration, its period and amendment history.

Independent Ottawa sector reporting provided a secondary cross-check of the EASE customer context and product positioning; House of Commons testimony separately corroborated the Ottawa company and CAF-support context.

leads.refreshSummary: Refresh the published H2 record in place with detailed current EASE workflow evidence, the amended DND contract value and a separately reviewable NRC IRAP LVC-integration program. Preserve the existing organization, capability and DND relationship IDs; do not promote the uncorroborated CAE LinkedIn teaming claim.
intendedChanges: Update the existing EASE capability in place with detailed official workflow, simulation-integration and assessment features.
Add the current DND EASE directed software contract as a separately reviewable program participation.
Add the NRC IRAP integrated LVC or simulation-module contribution as a separately reviewable program participation.
Append bounded current public activity, source context and discovery-only boundary language to the profile data.
